 Fort Bend County District Court

 Dylan Thomas, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Dylan Thomas

April 20, 2025
Location:
Offices of Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
Examining attorney:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Carlos Fox, Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather keep my name out of the record for now, if that's acceptable. I can give you the basics about the accident.
Q: That's fine for today. Tell me what you remember about the collision in Pearland.
A: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon, in the right lane of a two-lane road with a light traffic flow. A car coming the
other way drifted into my lane. I braked and turned slightly, but we still made contact. It was a head-on hit, though not a hard one.
My car's airbags did not deploy.
Q: How fast were you traveling at the time?
A: Not fast. Somewhere around the posted limit, maybe a little under. I remember the other car was also moving slowly.
Q: Did you feel anything immediately after the impact?
A: My head snapped forward and then back. My neck felt stiff within a few minutes, and by the next morning my lower back was
sore too.
Q: Did you seek medical care?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening, and then I followed up with my primary doctor. They diagnosed a neck strain and
a lower back strain and gave me a treatment plan.
Q: What did that plan involve?
A: Some physical therapy sessions, a couple of weeks of muscle relaxants, and advice to avoid heavy lifting. I also used a heating
pad a lot.
Q: How has the injury affecetd your daily routine?
A: Mostly in small ways. Driving for longer than about thirty minutes bothers my neck. I had to ask a coworker to cover a few
tasks that required bending or lifting. I still go to the gym, but I do fewer exercises and I stop when my back starts to ache.
Q: Are you still receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I still go to physical therapy about twice a week. My doctor says I'm improving, though it's slower than I'd like.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back complaints?
A: Nothing serious. I had a stiff neck once or twice from sleeping wrong, but I never saw a doctor for it and I never missed work
because of my back bfeore this.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you want to add to your answers?
A: Only that I want to be accurate. Some days are better than others, and I'm trynig to describe things as they actually are.
</page>
